show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Melanie Pickett – Modern Technology in the Investment Office at Northern Trust (Capital Allocators, EP.281)
summary:
We cover the evolution of
Northern Trust’s business for asset owners and Melanie’s
perspective on trends in asset allocation, technology, performance
and risk management, data science, and the future Melanie joined Northern Trust five years ago to create its Front
Office Solutions business, which today works with $450 billion on
the platform across more than forty asset owner clients. Prior to
Northern Trust, she spent six years as Chief Operating Officer at
Emory University’s investment office and over a decade rising to
Executive Director in investment operations at Morgan Stanley.
